Done! I've added the `create_invoice_handler(service, user, body)` function to `invoicing/api.py`. 

The handler:
- Takes the invoice id and items from the request body
- Creates LineItem objects for each item (which validates qty > 0)
- Creates an Invoice with the user as the customer
- Calls `service.create()` to save it
- Returns `(201, {"id": id, "created": date})` on success
- Returns `(400, {"error": code})` if any item is invalid (e.g., BAD_QTY for invalid quantity)
